static uint32_t filtered_adc = 0;
	  static uint8_t filter_ready = 0;

	  uint32_t raw;
	  uint32_t brightness;
	  char message[100];

	  if (HAL_ADC_Start(&hadc1) == HAL_OK)
	  {
	      if (HAL_ADC_PollForConversion(&hadc1, 20) == HAL_OK)
	      {
	          raw = HAL_ADC_GetValue(&hadc1);

	          if (!filter_ready)
	          {
	              filtered_adc = raw;
	              filter_ready = 1;
	          }
	          else
	          {
	              /* Loc mu: 75% gia tri cu + 25% mau moi */
	              filtered_adc = (3U * filtered_adc + raw) / 4U;
	          }

	          /*
	           * Gioi han ban dau o 64/255 de thu.
	           * Sau khi nguon va day on dinh co the tang len.
	           */
	          const uint32_t max_level = 64U;

	          if (filtered_adc <= 2250U)
	          {
	              brightness = 0;
	          }
	          else if (filtered_adc >= 3750U)
	          {
	              brightness = max_level;
	          }
	          else
	          {
	              brightness =
	                  (filtered_adc - 2250U) * max_level / 1500U;
	          }

	          /* Trang: R = G = B */
	          HAL_StatusTypeDef led_status = WS_SetAll(
	              (uint8_t)brightness,
	              (uint8_t)brightness,
	              (uint8_t)brightness);

	          snprintf(message, sizeof(message),
	                   "ADC=%lu | Filter=%lu | LED=%lu/255 | TX=%d\r\n",
	                   (unsigned long)raw,
	                   (unsigned long)filtered_adc,
	                   (unsigned long)brightness,
	                   (int)led_status);

	          UART_SendText(message);
	      }
	      else
	      {
	          UART_SendText("ADC timeout\r\n");
	      }

	      HAL_ADC_Stop(&hadc1);
	  }

	  HAL_Delay(100);
